correctness.rationale: For any word avoiding 11 with m ones, split at the ones into m+1 zero gaps. The number of long interior gaps c, truncated boundary lengths u and v, and total excess h completely determine the 3-Abelian factor count vector, and are all recoverable from it. Choose c of m-1 gaps and weakly compose h among r long gaps to obtain the exact binomial product, including the r=0 exception. This proves existence and cardinality of every fiber for all n; summing feasible parameter points produces the rational class-count and singleton-count series without extrapolation. The two independently implemented checkers agree for all actual constrained words through n=23 and parameter sums through n=130, while the proof covers arbitrary lengths.
risks: The statement assumes complete factor counts and cannot be transferred to endpoint-free or noisy observations. The finite checks do not themselves constitute the all-length proof.
